# Club Copy

> Club Copy is an independent Pacific Northwest record label based in British Columbia, Canada. House, jungle, and adjacent electronic music — digital and cassette.

Club Copy is a record label (not a mail-order record club). Published under Copy House Publishing. Founded by Charlie Archer (CJ Archer).
